decisions.reason: The white-label test vinyl series builds directly on the firm's vinyl, label and collector-catalog knowledge, so management can read early demand and adjust it. Limited-run test pressings and the lack of formal R&D add some risk of discontinuation.

A German new wave compilation series sits close to the firm's in-house label expertise in curated compilations for collectors, so it can assimilate feedback and extend the series with little new knowledge.
